translations.answer: In the skill distribution and short-time domain settings of BeyondMimic, future states and latent actions are jointly generated and integrated with waypoint, speed, keyframe, or SDF cost gradient during diffusion denoising. This allows the combination of existing skills without retraining the policy. A horizon of 0.64 seconds, guidance weights, state estimation, and transition transient limits are used to act as long-range planning or safe obstacle avoidance in the environment.
translations.applicability.assumptions.0: A reliable tracker and state estimator provide the reported state/latent interface.
translations.applicability.assumptions.1: Downstream objectives are differentiable over the short predicted trajectory.
translations.confidence_rationale: A strong latent ablation and extensive real demonstrations support the design, but task experiments are mostly qualitative, the public repository covers only the motion-tracking layer rather than latent diffusion/guidance, and several tasks depend on MoCap.
translations.evidence.0.locator: Figures 5-8 and Materials and Methods state-latent diffusion/guidance equations
translations.evidence.0.note: Supports short-horizon state-action generation, cost composition and key representation/sampling/latency ablations.
